name: ω-net rendering network
aliases: READ (Large-Scale Neural Scene Rendering for Autonomous Driving)
definition: A neural network proposed to learn neural descriptors from sparse point clouds, filter them through basic gate modules, and fuse features of same and different scales to synthesize photo-realistic driving scenes.
summary: The ω-net rendering network synthesizes photo-realistic large-scale driving scenes from sparse 3D point clouds using multi-scale feature fusion to prevent artifacts common in NeRF-based methods.
